children: Overview
UK property trust's H1 NAV per share fell due to costs and asset valuation decline
Board is considering delisting and expects to enter liquidation after Far Ralia sale
Outlook
Company aims to sell Far Ralia and enter liquidation, returning net proceeds to shareholders
Timing and value of Far Ralia sale will impact future shareholder distributions
Uncertainty in carbon credit and natural capital markets continues to weigh on investor confidence
Result Drivers
ASSET VALUATION - Co said decrease in NAV per share was mainly due to reduction in Far Ralia valuation
OPERATING COSTS - Ongoing running costs exceeded interest income, contributing to NAV decline
MARKET UNCERTAINTY - Uncertainty over carbon credits and natural capital markets has delayed sale of Far Ralia
